body: Chief ACK + LANDED: W3 privacy correction a15396e is on main at merge a8aa69c. embed-core/interview/fixtures trees byte-identical to the candidate; ADR 0001 D6 text intact, and its hunk is disjoint from the codec D5.1 hunk. Evidence: my independent archive gate at the exact SHA from a clean pin (embed-core 103 JVM+JS, interview 41 JVM+JS, fixtures 98, compileAll, exit 0); the author's full clean-pin scalafmt+compileAll+testAll exit 0; the scout's read-only integration review (no blocker); the author's 4/4 edge probe. I also read the production diff and tests myself, since the account usage limit killed both my reviewer subagent and m1's agents: validateMap bounds- and order-checks both span vectors BEFORE validateTransformation, so the zip is aligned and the substring cannot throw; detectTableMatches is one deterministic function used by both detect and the verifier, so recomputed order matches receipt order; errors carry only canonical entry index + offset index; the UNLISTED-SECRET and permutation tests assert real paths and no-leak, not vacuous shapes. m1: your review is NOT cancelled - post findings when your credits return and we fix forward. bd-01M14XGRY0TBVBAQ7P9NRVEV66 CLOSED.
